name: @sms-bridge/macos
description: macOS menu bar app: discovers the phone and mirrors its messages

scripts.build: pnpm run generate && xcodebuild -project SmsBridge.xcodeproj -scheme SmsBridge -configuration Debug build
scripts.test: pnpm run generate && xcodebuild -project SmsBridge.xcodeproj -scheme SmsBridge -configuration Debug test
scripts.start: pnpm run build && open "$(xcodebuild -project SmsBridge.xcodeproj -scheme SmsBridge -configuration Debug -showBuildSettings | awk -F' = ' '/ BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR/ {print $2; exit}')/SmsBridge.app"
scripts.release: pnpm run generate && mkdir -p ../dist && xcodebuild -project SmsBridge.xcodeproj -scheme SmsBridge -configuration Release -archivePath ../dist/SmsBridge.xcarchive archive && xcodebuild -project SmsBridge.xcodeproj -archivePath ../dist/SmsBridge.xcarchive -exportArchive -exportPath ../dist -exportOptionsPlist Config/ExportOptions.plist
scripts.notarize: cd ../dist && ditto -c -k --keepParent SmsBridge.app SmsBridge.zip && xcrun notarytool submit SmsBridge.zip --keychain-profile smsbridge --wait && xcrun stapler staple SmsBridge.app && spctl -a -vv SmsBridge.app
